description: This file defines the BasicUserRoleManager class within the OrangeHRM system, responsible for managing user roles, permissions, and access controls, including role instantiation, permission checks, and retrieval of accessible entities and modules. It acts as a central point for authorization logic related to user roles and their associated permissions within the HR management system.

classes.name: BasicUserRoleManager
classes.description: A class that manages user roles, permissions, and access rights, providing methods for role initialization, permission checks, fetching accessible entities, handling workflows, and module access control within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the role configurations and instantiates role objects.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes the predefined user role classes with their respective class names.

methods.name: getUserRoleClass
methods.description: Retrieves the user role object corresponding to a given role name.

methods.name: getScreenPermissionService
methods.description: Returns an instance of ScreenPermissionService, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: setScreenPermissionService
methods.description: Setter for injecting a custom ScreenPermissionService instance.

methods.name: getHomePageDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of HomePageDao, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: setHomePageDao
methods.description: Setter for injecting a custom HomePageDao instance.

methods.name: getAccessFlowStateMachineService
methods.description: Returns an instance of AccessFlowStateMachineService, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntities
methods.description: Retrieves entities accessible to the user based on role permissions and filters.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntityProperties
methods.description: Fetches properties of entities that the user can access, considering roles and filters.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntityIds
methods.description: Gets IDs of entities the user has access to, based on permissions and role filters.

methods.name: isActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a specific workflow action is permitted for the user in a given state.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Retrieves allowed workflow actions for the user in a workflow at a specific state.

methods.name: getActionableStates
methods.description: Returns states where specified actions are permissible for the current user.

methods.name: getUniqueActionsBasedOnPriority
methods.description: Merges multiple workflow action items, prioritizing based on their priority value.

methods.name: isEntityAccessible
methods.description: Determines if a specific entity is accessible to the user.

methods.name: areEntitiesAccessible
methods.description: Checks if multiple entities are accessible based on user permissions.

methods.name: getEmployeesWithRole
methods.description: Returns employees assigned to a specific role.

methods.name: getAccessibleModules
methods.description: Method not implemented, intended to retrieve accessible modules.

methods.name: isModuleAccessible
methods.description: Method not implemented, checks if a module is accessible.

methods.name: isScreenAccessible
methods.description: Method not implemented, checks if a screen is accessible.

methods.name: isFieldAccessible
methods.description: Method not implemented, checks if a field is accessible.

methods.name: getScreenPermissions
methods.description: Fetches permissions for a specific screen within a module.

methods.name: getApiPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves permissions for a specific API class based on user roles.

methods.name: computeUserRoles
methods.description: Calculates the roles associated with a given user, including supervisor and admin roles.

methods.name: areRequiredPermissionsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a user role has all of the required permissions for certain actions.

methods.name: mergeEmployees
methods.description: Merges two employee lists, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: filterRoles
methods.description: Filters roles based on inclusion, exclusion, and entity-related criteria.

methods.name: isSupervisorFor
methods.description: Checks if the current user is supervisor for a given employee ID.

methods.name: isProjectAdmin
methods.description: Checks if the user is a project administrator.

methods.name: isHiringManager
methods.description: Checks if the user is a Hiring Manager.

methods.name: isInterviewer
methods.description: Checks if the user is an Interviewer.

methods.name: getDataGroupService
methods.description: Returns an instance of DataGroupService, instantiating if needed.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves resource permissions for a data group, filtered by roles.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissionCollection
methods.description: Gets a collection of data group permissions based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getModuleDefaultPage
methods.description: Determines the default page for a module based on user roles and page enablement.

methods.name: getHomePage
methods.description: Returns the homepage for the user based on role priorities.

methods.name: fixUserRoleNameForWorkflowStateMachine
methods.description: Adjusts role names for workflow state machine compatibility.

methods.name: getAccessibleQuickLaunchList
methods.description: Fetches a list of accessible quick launch items based on user roles and permissions.
